data_fields.name: panel_exclusion_table
data_fields.donor_constant: main evicts chat+side; chat evicts main+side; side evicts main+chat; openMainSideModal evicts chat only

best_idea: Keep one exclusive panel slot per kind, send only the slots that changed once per tick, and refuse any click on a panel the engine does not record as open.
decision_why: Frankendom's HUD is client-only, so rendering stays in the client; only the open-panel record and the click gate move into the engine, keyed per slot so the donor's stale-field defect cannot happen.
acceptance: A server test opens main panel X, then side panel Y; a click on a component of X is rejected (isVisible(X) false), and the flush in that tick sends close main and open side, so the client shows only Y.
